description: Synthetic evaluation scenarios for Agent-Skills routing and triggers.

scenarios.query: design a new RESTful endpoint contract for user registration with proper validation
set up github actions workflow to run automated lint and test checks on pull requests
please review this diff across correctness, security, and edge cases before merging
diagnose this unhandled null pointer exception crash and stack trace in the worker service
audit third-party npm packages for vulnerabilities and upgrade outdated dependencies
document architectural decision record for adopting Redis session storage
resolve git rebase merge conflicts and prepare atomic clean commits
add OpenTelemetry distributed tracing and structured JSON logs with correlation IDs
audit and prevent SQL injection, cross-site scripting (XSS), and sanitize user inputs
write unit tests first using test-driven development before implementing interest calculator
prepare handoff document with repository state and open tasks for the next agent session
audit website against WCAG 2.2 AA standards for keyboard navigation and screen reader contrast
define CSS design tokens and color semantic variables for dark mode theming
make this dashboard layout responsive across mobile viewports using container queries and flexbox
create and validate UIDL document schema for rendering dynamic data tables and form filters
optimize Core Web Vitals to fix poor Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) and render-blocking scripts
write end-to-end browser tests using Playwright to verify checkout flow and payment modal
create PanacheEntity JPA mapping with Flyway migration safe on PostgreSQL production table
configure role-based access control with RolesAllowed and Argon2id password hashing in Quarkus
build streaming XLSX Excel export endpoint using POI SXSSF that will not run out of memory
enforce multi-tenant isolation using tenant context and row-level security
prevent cross-tenant records appearing when pooled connections switch customer organizations
decide which private client notes belong in a shared context pack and its access boundary
multi-tenant worker trusts forged tenant id and reads cross-tenant data without membership verification
scenarios.expected_decision: Reject the untrusted scope; verify actor and job ownership, establish a fresh context, and test with the restricted database role.

scenarios.query: implement subscription billing with usage metering proration and dunning
reconcile recurring plan upgrades per-seat pricing and premium entitlement limits
build streaming XLSX export using POI SXSSF to avoid running out of memory
subscription billing receives duplicate Stripe webhooks out of order after cancellation
scenarios.expected_decision: Persist verified events durably, serialize subscription reconciliation, and avoid restoring canceled access from a stale snapshot.

scenarios.query: add feature flags with deterministic targeting percentage rollout and a kill switch
keep release toggles stable by tenant cohort and retire flag debt after canary exposure
subscription billing must charge recurring usage and calculate proration on plan upgrades
feature flag provider is unavailable and a kill switch has stale targeting rules
scenarios.expected_decision: Use the documented per-flag fallback and staleness policy, retain authorization checks, and measure propagation before claiming immediate disablement.

scenarios.query: design product analytics event taxonomy activation funnels and retention cohorts
measure customer activation and churn using deduplicated behavioral events and cohort denominators
add OpenTelemetry tracing structured logs correlation IDs and Prometheus alerts
product analytics activation funnel includes email addresses and duplicate conversion events
scenarios.expected_decision: Minimize and allowlist properties, respect consent, deduplicate event IDs, and preserve a defined metric denominator.

scenarios.query: build tenant provisioning onboarding suspension and offboarding lifecycle
resume failed organization provisioning and safely deprovision its workspace after a retention hold
explain entry points architecture and mental model of an unfamiliar repository
tenant offboarding runs while a provisioning retry and legal retention hold remain active
scenarios.expected_decision: Fence provisioning, revoke access, validate the hold and approved retention policy, and prevent retries or restores from resurrecting deleted data.

scenarios.query: design identity access management with RBAC ABAC SSO MFA and SCIM deprovisioning
enforce organization-scoped permissions and revoke stale sessions after enterprise directory removal
configure RolesAllowed and Argon2id password hashing in Quarkus
SSO login auto-links accounts by email and SCIM deprovisioning leaves privileged sessions active
scenarios.expected_decision: Bind issuer and subject to a verified organization, require safe linking, invalidate permission caches and sessions, and test revocation.

scenarios.query: implement membership invitations renewal expiry benefits and owner transfer
manage association members with eligibility tiers joining dates suspension and reactivation
implement tenant row-level security and cross-tenant storage isolation
replayed membership invitation permits role escalation while concurrent owner removal leaves no owner
scenarios.expected_decision: Consume a scoped hashed invitation once, restrict granted roles, and enforce last-owner protection transactionally.

scenarios.query: build background jobs with transactional outbox retries worker leases and dead-letter replay
recover scheduled tasks after worker crashes without duplicating external side effects
create GitHub Actions pipeline lint checks and build gates for pull requests
background job worker crashes after sending an external effect before acknowledging its lease
scenarios.expected_decision: Use a stable effect idempotency key or reconciliation; recover the lease with fencing and do not claim broker delivery is exactly-once execution.

scenarios.query: build inbound outbound webhook delivery with signed payloads endpoint validation and replay
reliably notify partner HTTPS endpoints with retries signature rotation and delivery receipts
reconcile subscription billing Stripe payment webhooks metering and proration
outbound webhook endpoint resolves to a private IP after redirect or DNS rebinding
scenarios.expected_decision: Block private and reserved destinations at connection time, prohibit redirects or revalidate every hop, and retain a scoped failed delivery record.

scenarios.query: implement append-only business audit trail with actor attribution redaction and retention
prove who changed an approved record and separate impersonator identity from the effective actor
add Micrometer metrics MDC correlation ID JSON logging and health probes in Quarkus
audit trail transport is unavailable while a privileged mutation leaks passwords into before-after snapshots
scenarios.expected_decision: Redact before persistence and atomically record the mutation with a local audit event or outbox; enforce the documented failure policy.

scenarios.query: design ERP bounded contexts master data multi-company boundaries and document lifecycles
separate legal entities branches and canonical master data across an enterprise resource planning system
design tenant row-level security and prevent cross-tenant cache leaks
ERP multi-company document references another legal entity and master data edits rewrite posted history
scenarios.expected_decision: Enforce scoped references, snapshot issued facts, and model authorized intercompany transfers as explicit linked documents.

scenarios.query: build double-entry accounting general ledger fiscal periods reversals and reconciliation
ensure journal debit and credit balance while closing books and preserving trial balance
subscription billing calculates recurring plan prices usage metering and dunning
duplicate journal posting races fiscal period close and leaves debit credit imbalance
scenarios.expected_decision: Post the balanced journal atomically under an idempotent source key and serialize the open-period check with closing; correct with a linked reversal.

scenarios.query: build inventory stock ledger reservations warehouse transfers lot and serial tracking
prevent overselling the last warehouse unit and reconcile stock counts with movement history
fix frontend client state duplicate server cache facts and prop drilling
two inventory reservations consume the final stock unit and a repeated warehouse receipt doubles availability
scenarios.expected_decision: Serialize or atomically condition reservations, deduplicate movement source keys, and preserve stock and reservation conservation.

scenarios.query: implement procurement purchase orders goods receipts supplier invoices and three-way matching
track requisitions partial receiving vendor invoice tolerances and purchasing commitments
configure generic maker-checker approval workflow delegation and escalation rules
procurement receives a partial delivery twice and a duplicate supplier invoice exceeds three-way match tolerance
scenarios.expected_decision: Deduplicate receipts and supplier invoices, compare cumulatively against authorized lines, and hold mismatches for explicit approval.

scenarios.query: implement sales quote-to-cash orders fulfillment receivables credit notes and returns
track customer orders partial shipments invoicing collections and returned goods without double fulfillment
build a double-entry general ledger trial balance and accounting period close
duplicate sales shipment invoices returned goods twice while a customer exceeds its credit limit
scenarios.expected_decision: Enforce cumulative quantities and idempotent source links, recheck credit exposure atomically, and link returns, stock receipts, and credit notes separately.

scenarios.query: build approval workflow maker-checker state machine delegation and escalation
freeze approver policy for submitted documents and reject self-approval of changed revisions
set up GitHub Actions build pipeline lint checks and automated quality gates
approval workflow delegate self-approves a stale document revision while another reviewer rejects it
scenarios.expected_decision: Revalidate current actor eligibility and segregation of duties, compare the submitted revision, and allow only one atomic state transition.

scenarios.query: build data import export with staging dry-run row errors schema mapping and reconciliation
ingest supplier CSV files with resumable batches preserving leading zeros decimal precision and external IDs
create a PanacheEntity JPA mapping and safe Flyway migration in PostgreSQL
data import resumes after a crash with foreign tenant references and formula injection in an exported CSV
scenarios.expected_decision: Reject unauthorized references, replay idempotent row keys under a fixed mapping version, and escape spreadsheet-executable cells without corrupting original data.

scenarios.query: membership invitation acceptance downgrades the final active owner and leaves the organization ownerless
scenarios.expected_decision: Apply the declared existing-member policy and owner invariant within invitation acceptance, not only member removal; reject unsafe downgrade without consuming the invitation.
